items.title: Fastrenteinnskudd hos Storebrand: 5,10 % ved 6 måneders binding
items.body:
Jeg så nå at Storebrand tilbyr 5,10 % nominell rente ved 6 måneders binding.

Jeg har 4,8 % uten binding i annen bank nå, men vurderer å flytte en del av dem.

Noen som har tro på at det kommer til å være noen som tilbyr særlig bedre det kommende halvåret?

items.title: Pint-sized gains: the Australian brewers crafting refreshingly sustainable beers
items.author: Jack Larkin
items.body:
As the weather warms up, renewable and refillable brews can help reduce the environmental cost of a cold one

•
Change by degrees offers life hacks and sustainable living tips each Saturday to help reduce your household’s carbon footprint

•
Got a question or tip for reducing household emissions? Email us at changebydegrees@theguardian.com

It’s no secret that Australians love getting on the beers: we consume 69m litres of the stuff every year.

With that comes a significant packaging and environmental footprint, as commercially produced drinks generate emissions in both production and transportation. Australians drink and dispose of an estimated 17bn bottles and cans a year, fewer than half of which are recycled.

items.title: Behemoth! review - Pedro Pascal classical music drama hits all the wrong notes
items.author: Owen Myers
items.body:
New York film festival: The actor stumbles through Tony Gilroy’s forgettable film marred by stylistic gimmicks

Tony Gilroy has built a sturdy career as the director of the Bourne films and show runner of the popular Star Wars spin-off Andor. He directed Tilda Swinton all the way to an Oscar for her remarkable performance in the legal potboiler Michael Clayton.

As the first feature film he has directed since 2012’s The Bourne Legacy, the classical music drama Behemoth! promised to be an intriguing return from a master of threading the needle between slick action and deeply felt drama. His new film comes with a score from nine A-list composers who have banded together and called themselves The Behemoth! Collective, a stacked cast and a womanizing central character who looks phenomenal in a tux: “Tár for straight men”, as a friend of mine put it.

items.title: Tankskip truffet utenfor Oman
items.author: NTB
items.body:
Mannskapet er i trygghet etter at et tankskip med råolje ble truffet av et uidentifisert prosjektil øst for Oman, melder den britiske overvåkingstjenesten UKMTO.

Meldingen om hendelsen kom natt til lørdag.

Skipets kaptein har opplyst at skipet ble truffet rundt fire nautiske mil utenfor kysten av Oman, ifølge den militære overvåkingsgruppa.

Foreløpig er det ikke meldt om miljøskadelige utslipp, og hele mannskapet rapporteres å være i trygghet.
